st.2: The Online Gaming Authority of India is an attached office of the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting.

x: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is wrong: the Authority is an attached office of MeitY. Statement 3 is wrong: the rules took effect on 1 May 2026. Statement 4 is wrong: gig and platform workers were first defined in the Code on Social Security, 2020.

st.1: The 6th BIMSTEC Summit (Bangkok, April 2025) had the theme "Prosperous, Resilient and Open", and Bangladesh took over the chair for the next summit.

x: All three statements are correct: the 6th Summit in Bangkok handed the chair to Bangladesh, the first Home Ministers' Meeting was in New Delhi on 13 October 2026 under Amit Shah, and the 3rd traditional-medicine conference was at Goa in September 2026.

st.3: The Secretary-General of ASEAN is Lim Jock Hoi.

x: Statements 1 and 4 are correct. Statement 2 is wrong: with Timor-Leste ASEAN has 11 members. Statement 3 is wrong: the Secretary-General is Kao Kim Hourn (Lim Jock Hoi was his predecessor).

st.2: UNEA-7 was held in Nairobi in December 2025.

x: All three statements are correct: COP31 is at Antalya with Australia leading negotiations, UNEA-7 met in Nairobi in December 2025, and its theme was "Advancing sustainable solutions for a resilient planet".

st.1: The BBNJ (High Seas) Treaty under UNCLOS entered into force on 17 January 2025.

x: Statement 3 is correct. Statement 1 is wrong: the BBNJ Treaty entered into force on 17 January 2026. Statement 2 is wrong: India has signed but not ratified it.

st.2: The joint hydro projects that give Bhutan about 90% of its installed capacity include Tala and Mangdechhu.

x: All three statements are correct: India committed ₹10,000 crore to Bhutan's 13th Plan, the joint projects include Chukha, Kurichhu, Tala and Mangdechhu (Pancheshwar is an India–Nepal project), and the 1949 Treaty was revised in February 2007.

st.1: Six private space firms were selected, each with a seed grant of up to ₹5 crore.

x: Neither statement is correct. Statement 1 is wrong: the seed grant is up to ₹1 crore each. Statement 2 is wrong: IN-SPACe was set up in 2020, but the Indian Space Policy came in 2023.

st.1: The IndiaAI Mission (2024, ₹10,371.92 crore) is under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology.

x: All three statements are correct: the IndiaAI Mission is under MeitY, the New Delhi AI Impact Summit Declaration was adopted by 92 countries/organisations, and Prof B. Ravindran is the only Indian on the UN scientific panel on AI.

st.1: India is a recognised Nuclear Weapon State under the NPT.

x: Statement 3 is correct. Statement 1 is wrong: only the USA, Russia, UK, France and China are recognised; India is not. Statement 2 is wrong: liability for damage on Earth is absolute (fault-based applies in outer space).

st.3: For plasma, the universal donor is group AB.

x: All three statements are correct: antigens are on red cells and antibodies in plasma, AB positive is the universal recipient, and AB is the universal plasma donor.

st.4: About 7,000 ha of it allegedly falls in ICRZ 2019 prohibited zones.

x: Statements 2 and 3 are correct. Statement 1 is wrong: the NGT upheld the environmental clearance. Statement 4 is wrong: about 700 ha allegedly falls in ICRZ prohibited zones.

st.4: Papikonda is AP's only Elephant Reserve.

x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is wrong: Seshachalam was declared in 2010. Statement 4 is wrong: AP's only Elephant Reserve is Koundinya.

st.2: The Archaeological Survey of India was set up in 1861 and works under the Ministry of Tourism.
st.3: Jaipur, named in National Geographic's "Best of the World 2027", was founded in 1727 by Maharaja Man Singh I.

x: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is wrong: the ASI works under the Ministry of Culture. Statement 3 is wrong: Jaipur was founded by Sawai Jai Singh II. Statement 4 is wrong: the World's 100 Best Museums ranking is by Worth a Journey (Germany).

st.3: Bengaluru, at 268th, was the highest-ranked Indian city.
st.1: It assesses 2,000 cities on five dimensions, including Governance and Environment.

x: None of the statements is correct. Statement 1 is wrong: the index covers 1,000 cities. Statement 2 is wrong: New York topped it, followed by London and Paris. Statement 3 is wrong: Delhi, at 268th, was the top Indian city.

st.2: Under ULLAS, Ladakh was declared fully literate in 2024 and Chandigarh in 2026.

x: All three statements are correct: Uttarakhand became the sixth fully literate State, Ladakh was declared in 2024 and Chandigarh in 2026, and the secondary GER was 77%.

st.1: Bihar had the highest TFR, 2.9.

x: All three statements are correct: Bihar had the highest TFR (2.9), Delhi the lowest (1.2), and 16 major States were below replacement level.

st.2: Government schools make up 48.1% of all schools.
st.4: The RTE Act, 2009 gives effect to Article 45.
st.1: NITI Aayog's report counts 14.71 lakh schools, with a higher secondary GER of 68.4%.

x: None of the statements is correct. Statement 1 is wrong: the higher secondary GER is 58.4%. Statement 2 is wrong: government schools make up 68.1%. Statement 3 is wrong: the Mudaliar Commission came in 1952 and the Kothari Commission in 1964–66. Statement 4 is wrong: the RTE Act gives effect to Article 21A.

st.1: For every USD 1 spent on protecting nature, about USD 3 goes to nature-degrading activities.
st.2: Nature-negative finance flows were about USD 17.3 trillion in 2023.

x: Statement 4 is correct. Statement 1 is wrong: the ratio is about USD 30 to 1. Statement 2 is wrong: nature-negative flows were about USD 7.3 trillion. Statement 3 is wrong: biodiversity spending rose by 11%.

st.1: A State is classified as 'ageing' when the share of people aged 60+ exceeds 10%.
st.2: Andhra Pradesh's 60+ share is 14.1% (2026) and it is expected to become an ageing State by 2041.

x: Statement 4 is correct. Statement 1 is wrong: 'ageing' means a 60+ share above 15% (10–15% is intermediate). Statement 2 is wrong: AP is expected to be ageing by 2031. Statement 3 is wrong: Telangana ranks 10th; AP is 5th.

st.3: 40% of Andhra Pradesh's districts have five or more extra very warm nights.

x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is wrong: the figure is 70% of AP's districts. Statement 4 is wrong: the heat islands listed are Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada, Rajahmundry, Tirupati and Guntur, not Kurnool.

st.2: Mamta Kalia won the 2025 award in English for Crimson Spring.

x: Statements 1 and 4 are correct. Statement 2 is wrong: Crimson Spring won for Navtej Sarna (Mamta Kalia won in Hindi). Statement 3 is wrong: Gurram Jashuva did not get the award for Gabbilam.

st.1: In the final of the Women's ODI World Cup 2025 at Navi Mumbai, India beat South Africa.

x: All three statements are correct: India beat South Africa in the 2025 final, the inaugural Women's Champions Trophy 2027 moved to India, and England hosted and won the first World Cup in 1973.

st.3: Bharat Singh Chauhan was re-elected Chair of the Commonwealth Chess Association at its AGM in Wadduwa, Sri Lanka.

x: Statements 1 and 3 are correct: FIDE joined IWGA as its 40th member, and Chauhan was re-elected at Wadduwa. Note: Arkady Dvorkovich was FIDE President until September 2026; Timur Turlov now holds the post.

st.1: Beach volleyball and canoeing-kayaking were new sports at the 4th Khelo India University Games.

x: Statement 3 is correct. Statement 1 is wrong: they were new at the 5th Khelo India University Games. Statement 2 is wrong: the programme was launched by the IOA, not the Sports Authority of India.

st.1: India beat South Korea in the final of the Kabaddi World Cup 2016 at Ahmedabad.

x: Statement 2 is correct. Statement 1 is wrong: India beat Iran in the 2016 final. Statement 3 is wrong: Season 12 was Dabang Delhi's second title (the first came in Season 8).

st.3: The relics of Sariputra and Maudgalyayana were exhibited at Erdene Zuu Monastery, Kharkhorin, in 2026.

x: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is wrong: the Annapurna idol came back from Canada. Statement 3 is wrong: the relics were exhibited at Gandan Tegchenling Monastery, Ulaanbaatar.

st.2: The Maratha Military Landscapes of India were inscribed at the 47th session in Riyadh.
st.1: The Ancient Buddhist Site of Sarnath was inscribed at the 47th session held at Busan, South Korea.

x: Statement 4 is correct. Statement 1 is wrong: Sarnath was inscribed at the 48th session. Statement 2 is wrong: the 47th session was held in Paris. Statement 3 is wrong: India hosted the 46th session at New Delhi in 2024.

st.3: The first Vande Bharat on the Jammu–Srinagar route ran over the Anji Khad Bridge, the world's highest railway bridge.

x: Statement 2 is correct. Statement 1 is wrong: the Missing Link tunnel is 22.33 m wide. Statement 3 is wrong: the world's highest railway bridge is the Chenab Bridge (Anji Khad is India's first cable-stayed rail bridge).

st.1: They were feudatories of the Rashtrakutas of Manyakheta.
st.2: Their capital moved from Dwarasamudra (Halebidu) to Belur.

x: Neither statement is correct. Statement 1 is wrong: the Hoysalas were feudatories of the Western Chalukyas of Kalyana. Statement 2 is wrong: the capital moved from Belur to Dwarasamudra.

st.2: Indira Point on Great Nicobar is the southernmost point of India.
